notes: Dutch professional brand (TKH Security). Official RTSP URL format from Siqura user manuals: rtsp://<IP>:<port>/VideoInput/<x>/<y>/<z> where <x>=Video Input number, <y>=media type (h264/mpeg4/mpeg2/mjpeg), <z>=encoder number (only ENABLED encoders of that media type are counted for the index). Default RTSP port 554. Leads 'VideoInput/1/h264/1' and 'VideoInput/1/mpeg4/1' match this format exactly and are confirmed. Cameras/encoders also support ONVIF Profile S (stream URIs queried via ONVIF, not fixed URLs). Same URL scheme documented across S-60 E, C-60 E, S-64 E, BC620WDR and other Siqura encoders/cameras.
